title: Desktop Automation MCP redacted audit event
description: Redacted audit event produced by the running server for every guarded action (allowed, denied, or errored). NOTE: the record NEVER carries image, typed text, window title, or region name; target_identity deliberately contains only the hwnd/pid/process_started_at triple. Screenshot operations carry only content-free privacy_context counters. denial_reason is required for denied/error and forbidden for allowed.

timestamp.description: Moment the event was produced; ISO-8601 date-time with MANDATORY numeric UTC offset (same rule as the other schemas). NOTE: an audit record is a retrospective observation; a past date is normal, expiry rejection does not apply.

correlation_id.description: Opaque 12-lowercase-hex-digit identity tracing the action call end to end. Exactly matches the running server's uuid4().hex[:12] output; it encodes neither content nor target identity.

policy_id.description: Opaque identity of the policy in effect at decision time (policy file version or environment-variable digest). This schema does not define HOW it is produced, only that it cannot be empty.

action_type.description: The audited action; exactly matches the server's KNOWN_ACTIONS set, unknown action names are rejected.

operation.description: Optional content-free tool/operation name (e.g. screenshot_window). Distinguishes different read kinds under action_type=observe.

privacy_context.description: Content-free privacy accounting for the screenshot family only. Carries no region name, title, text, hash, or pixel content.

outcome.description: Action outcome: allowed (executed), denied (policy rejection), error (technical failure).

denial_reason.description: Rejection/technical-error reason; contains no sensitive data (title, text, image summary). Required only when outcome is denied or error.

duration_ms.description: Time for the action to pass the policy gate, in milliseconds.

target_identity.description: Optional target identity (hwnd/pid/process-start-time). The audit schema carries no title; image, text, and title are never stored.

hwnd.description: Window handle of the target top-level window.

pid.description: Process ID of the process owning the target window.

process_started_at.description: Process start time (FILETIME-like); guards against PID reuse.
